sheets.name: Notes
rows: Working capital absorbed cash in H1 because two large distributors paid late, pushing DSO to 58 days.
Collections improved in Q3 after invoices moved to 30-day terms with automatic reminders; DSO target is 45 days.
The revolving credit facility of $10,000k was undrawn all year.
Capital expenditure funds the new inspection line at the south plant.
